description: This file defines the `TwigTest` class, which represents a template test in the Twig templating engine. It extends the `AbstractTwigCallable` class and manages test configurations such as callable implementations and options related to Twig's test expressions.

classes.name: TwigTest
classes.description: Represents a template test in Twig, allowing configuration of test callables and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TwigTest with a name, optional callable, and options. Sets default options including node class and argument requirements.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'test', indicating the type of Twig element.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need charset information.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need environment information.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need context information.

methods.name: hasOneMandatoryArgument
methods.description: Checks if the test requires exactly one mandatory argument based on options.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of arguments required, inheriting from parent and adding one.
